item.name: Get most recent verified name for the request user or for the specified username

request.name: Get most recent verified name for the request user or for the specified username

description.content:
For example: /edx_name_affirmation/v1/verified_name?username=jdoe
Example response: {
    "username": "jdoe",
    "verified_name": "Jonathan Doe",
    "profile_name": "Jon Doe",
    "verification_attempt_id": 123,
    "proctored_exam_attempt_id": None,
    "status": "approved",
    "use_verified_name_for_certs": False,
}
